propositions: Mutation gate hard-fails with exit code 2 when scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent from the checked-out patchset tree, occurring for changes based on commits older than the walking-skeleton commit that introduced the script
The gate executes a reusable workflow from refs/heads/main against the checked-out patchset tree, creating a mismatch when the patchset predates the script's introduction
Sibling gates (env-var registry, comment hygiene) already guard against this condition by checking for file existence and skipping cleanly with an explanatory message rather than failing
The mutation gate must implement the same file-existence guard to skip cleanly (exit 0) when scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent, preventing spurious Verified -1 on older changes
Changes based on or after the script's introduction should still run the gate for real, not silently bypass it
